about_the_game:
Become a Founder, Shape the Game


As a Founder, you’ll influence Towerborne’s development, get unique rewards, and gain a special in-game status. Your support is vital in crafting a dynamic and engaging experience for all players. Your Founder content carries over to any platform through our cross-progression system.

The Platinum Founder's Pack includes Gold and Silver Founder's Pack contents plus additional items:

  • Early Access to Towerborne allows you to play the game before its full release, providing an opportunity to influence its development with your feedback
  • Cosmetic Set: Longship (Founder Exclusive)
  • Umbra Skin: Thrasher Iska (Founder Exclusive)
  • Emote: Bellower’s Scream
  • Silver Monthly Founder Bonus Item
  • Gold Monthly Founder Bonus Item
  • Cosmetic Set: Jarlbone (Founder Exclusive)
  • Umbra Skin: Warhawk Pox (Founder Exclusive)
  • Umbra Skin: Strongarm Sten (Founder Exclusive)
  • Umbra Skin: Backbiter Morby (Founder Exclusive)
  • 3 Curio Cores - Curio Cores are needed to unlock Premium Curios (and can be used anytime to unlock any Curio).
  • Additional 4,000 Belfry Bucks* (5,000 total) - In-game currency to make purchases in the Towerborne store to customize your looks, gear, weapons and more.

    Towerborne is a new Looter Brawler, combining side-scrolling combat with ARPG loot progression and customization.* Unite with other Aces to defend the Belfry, humanity’s last refuge. Can you become the Ace humanity needs? Explore, fight, and grow stronger together.

    Explore Together – With an evolving world map and ongoing updates, your adventure continues with new enemies, regions, rewards, and story. Venture solo or with up to three other Aces and recruit Umbra allies with unique abilities to join your fight. Return to the Belfry to reforge gear and continue your journey.

    Fight Your Way – Jump into satisfying, pick-up-and-play brawler combat that's easy to learn but challenging to master. Towerborne delivers fast-paced, thrilling battles with deep, evolving strategy as you progress. Every fight is a chance to sharpen your skills and face tougher challenges.

    Endless Customization* – Customize your Ace's appearance, gear, and weapons. Set your preferred danger level in the Wilds, wield powerful weapons with special moves, and mix gear and Umbra companions to create a playstyle that's uniquely yours.

    *This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10 64bit | Win 11 64bit
  • Processor: Quad Core 3.2 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p native resolution. Low-Medium graphics settings. 30-60fps. Controller recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10 64bit | Win 11 64bit
  • Processor: Quad Core 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2070 / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p native resolution. High-Epic graphics settings. 60fps. Controller recommended.
